name: spike
description: Spike rules for Claude Code: at a fork during agreed work Claude settles it with evidence and keeps going, before writing a helper it looks for an existing solution, and /spike <question> runs the full method (official docs, Context7, the installed source, then a live run). Works best with Firecrawl and Context7.

suggest_tools.title: Suggest Firecrawl and Context7
suggest_tools.description: on: when a spike runs without Firecrawl or Context7, Claude suggests installing them, once per session. off: Claude only says which source it skipped.
